subject: Coordination: SOC 2 evidence escrow & incident-IR bridging
messages:
From: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@pinnaclebank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: poc-security@pinnaclebank.com
Date: 2026-11-07T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: SOC 2 evidence escrow + incident bridging for recent outage

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick tabletop last week. As part of Pinnacle's ongoing vendor SOC 2 review we need two items from Redwood: a) a short, redacted post-incident timeline and b) a secure evidence-escrow handoff for the artifacts we discussed (logs, sanitized telemetry, redaction notes).

Attached is Pinnacle_SOC2_Request_v2.xlsx that lists the control areas we need mapped (common categories + specific SIG/CAIQ references). Can you confirm whether Redwood can:
  - produce a redacted postmortem suitable for external auditors (PII removed, internal IP redacted),
  - provide an escrow transfer (S3 pre-signed with encryption + expiration OR vendor-managed secure transfer) with an MD5/SHA256 manifest we can verify, and
  - map the provided artifacts back to SIG/CAIQ controls?

We're aiming to complete artifact collection by 2026-11-14 to meet our audit window. If you can point to a single owner and an estimated delivery cadence, that would help our procurement team finalize the checklist.

Appreciate it—
Samantha Liu
Senior IT Risk Analyst
Pinnacle Bank

Attachment: Pinnacle_SOC2_Request_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@pinnaclebank.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-07T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 evidence escrow + incident bridging for recent outage

Samantha—

Thanks for the clear list and timeline. We can support the three asks; summary and proposed plan below. I've attached a redaction-friendly postmortem template (redacted-postmortem-template.docx) so you can see the level of detail we intend to provide.

Proposed deliverables and owners:
- Redacted incident timeline & summary (owner: Marissa Cole) — targeted delivery: 2026-11-10 EOD
- Evidence manifest (CSV with filenames + SHA256 hashes) and retention metadata (owner: Karthik Iyer) — targeted delivery: 2026-11-12
- Secure handoff: encrypted S3 pre-signed URL (7-day expiry) + optional vendor escrow via encrypted ZIP (owner: Jordan Blake) — target ready by 2026-11-12

Mapping to SIG/CAIQ: we'll produce a 1:1 crosswalk that ties artifacts to control IDs. That will be a short matrix (artifact -> control IDs -> redaction status). We will flag any artifacts that require redaction and include a brief justification for the redaction.

Two quick clarifications before we proceed:
1) Which format do you prefer for verification of integrity? We can provide SHA256 (recommended) and PGP-signed manifest if you need a non-repudiable signature.
2) Any constraints on what we can include in the redacted postmortem (e.g., no vendor named IP, strict verbatim timestamps removed)? We will default to removing customer identifiers and internal hostnames.

If that plan looks good I will kick off the evidence collection and share a Drive folder link and a HubSpot deal note for tracking.

Marissa Cole
Director, Trust & Security
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redacted-postmortem-template.docx (docx stub)
From: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@pinnaclebank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: poc-security@pinnaclebank.com
Date: 2026-11-07T11:27:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 evidence escrow + incident bridging for recent outage

Marissa—

That cadence works for us. A few notes in response:
- SHA256 + PGP-signed manifest is ideal. Please include a human-readable manifest as well (filename, size, last-modified, SHA256).
- For the redacted postmortem, removing customer identifiers/hostnames is fine; preserve event timestamps (UTC) but you may shift or obfuscate session IDs and IPs. Our auditors accept redacted UTC timestamps as long as the sequence is accurate.
- For escrow delivery, we prefer an encrypted S3 pre-signed URL plus a signed manifest (PGP) rather than vendor escrow unless Redwood recommends otherwise.

One operational ask: can Redwood also include a short bridging statement that explains how the incident timeline maps to the SOC 2 incident reporting and evidence retention policies (one paragraph, suitable for appendix)? That will help our auditor connect the timeline to control criteria.

We'll plan a 30-min sync tomorrow (2026-11-08) if you have availability—suggest 10:00 AM PT.

Thanks,
Samantha

Attachment: none
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@pinnaclebank.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-07T15:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 evidence escrow + incident bridging for recent outage

Samantha—

All good. Quick confirmations and next steps:  
- Integrity format: SHA256 + PGP-signed CSV manifest (we will sign with our security key).
- Redaction rules: remove customer names & hostnames; preserve UTC timestamps (we will include an obfuscation table mapping original session IDs to redacted tokens for auditor review under NDA).
- Escrow method: encrypted S3 (AES-256) pre-signed URL + PGP-signed manifest. If you later require vendor-managed escrow, Jordan will own that conversation.

Action items (owners):
- Marissa: Draft redacted postmortem and one-paragraph bridging statement — due 2026-11-10 EOD
- Karthik: Produce evidence manifest + compute SHA256 hashes — due 2026-11-12 EOD
- Jordan: Prepare secure S3 bucket policy and presigned URL plan; handle procurement/contract questions — will follow up by 2026-11-09

Meeting: Confirmed 2026-11-08 10:00 AM PT — invite to follow. I've created a working Drive folder and a HubSpot note (link below) for artifact upload and tracking.

Drive link: https://drive.redwood.ai/teams/security/pinnacle-evidence-manifest
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/99321

If anything from procurement or legal changes the scope, loop Jordan. Otherwise we will start preparing the materials and notify you when the manifest is ready for signature verification.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Trust & Security
Redwood Inference

Attachment(s): evidence-manifest-hash.csv (to be generated)
